full_judgment: 2. The case of respondent Nos. 1 and 2 who were writ petitioners before the High Court Division is that their 0.25 acre of land in Plot Nos. 46 and 47 in khatian Nos. 948 and 955 of mouza Gutatik of Sylhet Town was acquired in LA Case No. 3/89-90. Their definite case is that respondent No. 7 in the writ petition who is petitioner now being unable to purchase the land in question prevailed upon the local authorities to acquire this land for Kadamtali Government Primary School. The present petitioner wanted to upgrade the said Primary School into a High School and with that end in view he moved the Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet and Director General, Primary Education and got the land acquired under section 3 of the Acquisition and Requisition of Immovable Property Ordinance, 1982 on 20-5-90. The Deputy Commissioner, Sylhet thereafter served notices for acquisition under sections 5 and 6 of the said Ordinance. The case of the writ petitioners is that the whole action of the present petitioner was to acquire the land with a malafide design as he failed to purchase the land himself.
